mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of persistent inflation above 2.5% annualized, the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12mo % change > 2.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 jobs per month signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals a contraction in manufacturing and services output, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate a severe economic slowdown that triggers a risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic labor market recovery (UNRATE < 7.0%), a monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100,000 signals accelerating economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 7.0 and PAYEMS growth > 100,000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
